title: Real flails: spin while held, launch on release, drag and retract, visible chain
player_outcome: Holding a flail swings the spiked ball around you, hitting anything close. Releasing hurls it at the cursor, where it drags along the ground before the chain reels it back. The chain from hand to ball is always visible.
design: Verified: ball_o_hurt etc. are 'item' visual returning projectiles that tumble the whole handle+chain+ball model (ProjectileRenderer.cs:85, 106-107).
TetherDef kind 'flail' gets phases on Projectile (TetherPhase: Spin, Launched, Retract).
Spin (while UseHeld from the first press): orbit the owner's hand at 1.1 m and 12 rad/s in a tilted plane, clearing HitNpcs every 12 ticks.
On release → Launched: velocity = Aim·ShootSpeed. Fly up to Range; gravity kicks in after 0.3 s; slide along the ground with friction.
Retract: after 1.5 s, at Range, or on a new press → Returning.

Extract GrappleVisual's diamond-link chain into a shared game/Rendering/ChainStrip.cs (links, width, colour) for reuse by hooks (P3-17). ProjectileRenderer.Tethers draws the flail chain from the hand 'chain' socket to the ball; the ball uses the tumble spin from data.
Animation: Hold('flail') during Spin; the throw clip plays on launch.
Sounds: 'flail_spin' every revolution at −8 dB and 'chain' rattle on launch (recipes in P3-27).
data_changes: ball_o_hurt, sunfury, blue_moon, flower_pow, flairon projectiles: drop 'returns'; add tether {kind: flail, range, speed}; model '<id>_ball'; spin 12 tumble; chain colour
solar_eruption stays a returning projectile until a bespoke lash (out of scope; note in docs)
tests: FlailTests: while held, a dummy 1 m away is hit repeatedly; after release the ball travels ≥ 4 m along the aim
FlailTests: the ball is removed within 180 ticks after launch; one flail at a time

Smoke combat.cmds: 'give ball_o_hurt 1' / 'wield ball_o_hurt' / 'press use_primary on' / 'wait 0.5' / 'assert projectiles.count == 1' / 'press use_primary off' / 'wait 3' / 'assert projectiles.count == 0'
verification: Lavapipe screenshots of the spin and launch phases with the chain visible
risks: Orbit collision against terrain: skip terrain collision in the Spin phase (Terraria does too).
GrappleVisual refactor overlaps P3-17; land P3-13 first.
